$comment: Project-level exceptions: corrections for popular extensions whose manifest says too little or too much. Keys are lower-case extension ids. User rules (autoDisableExtensions.extensions) override these.

dbaeumer.vscode-eslint.$comment: Does nothing without ESLint in the project.

esbenp.prettier-vscode.$comment: Only formats when chosen as formatter; projects using it carry a dependency or a config file.

bierner.markdown-mermaid.$comment: Declares no language. The detector reports `mermaid` for .mmd files and ```mermaid blocks in Markdown.
